pkgmetadata.longdescription: Small add-ons for the Window Maker window manager, in plain C: a freedesktop notification daemon, a column file browser, a menu generator, dock helpers and settings. Everything takes its colours, textures and fonts from the active Window Maker theme. Dockapps are left alone.

use.flag: Build wmfiles, the column file browser (needs Xft)
Build wmnotify, the notification daemon, and wmnotify-send (needs D-Bus and Xft)
Use libwraster for exact gradient textures and PNG/XPM notification icons
